notes.title: (Important Update!) Press M to Meow
notes.content:
Important Update!

We're excited to introduce awesome new features in our latest update:

[list]
[*]Press M to meow on the keyboard.
[*]Press X to meow on the controller.
[/list]

Happy meowing ːsummercat2023ː

notes.title: Push The Cat with WASD IS OUT NOW! 🐈
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795881/afb3b2e0c9dacb735a207ff076447f7a04894ec0.png[/img]

Push The Cat with WASD is now available on Steam!🐱

You can push cats now! ✨


Update v20240620.0

- Remove music at level 7-01 so you can feel the silence and peace
- Change solution on level 3-06
- Add X on level 3-09 so you can't push the cat! (Oh no!)
- Add more arrows on chapter 4

Thank you!


Please help push to remember.
